Name: Fishing-Only Challenge
Author: OFTSCQM
Description:
[size=5]Install[/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list][size=5]
Requirements[/size]
[list]
[*]You can only obtain money (whether through selling to NPC, placing in shipping bins, or using trash cans) through completing quests, selling fish and fish-related items, including fish after being processed by fish smokers, crab pot fish, other catchables (seaweed, algae, and jellies), bait, and roes. 
[*]Non Fishing-related Items will NOT be able to shipped or sell at shops. Non fishing-related items can be trashed but will not gain money. 
[*]Perfection will not ask you to ship anything beyond fishes. 
[*]Quests in this mod will solely be based on [b]fishing-related[/b] items only. 
[*]All special orders are modified to make sure they are fishing-related. 
[*]All non fishing-related quests are either removed or set to have no reward. 
[*][b]Preserved jars[/b] can be used to age roes.
[/list]

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.6.15+ on Linux/Mac/Windows.
[*]Works in single-player, multiplayer, and split-screen mode.
[/list][size=5]Known Issue:[/size]
[list]
[*][size=2]There may be yellow warnings saying "Failed to load quest....." This is completely normal as we removed some non fishing-related quests, and thus the game couldn't find some specific quests. [/size]
[/list]
